QuestInfo.name: Reborn Mist Cutter
QuestInfo.0: Princess Sakuno has requested your presence! What could it be?
QuestInfo.1: Princess Sakuno has requested your presence! What could it be?
QuestInfo.2: The Mist Cutter, your family's treasured blade, was thought lost during the battle with Nobunaga. Now, Princess Sakuno has reforged it into a 'Fire Phoenix Blade.' May it serve you well.

0.0: Hayato, a scout found the pieces of a blade in the forest. I believe it was yours, so I took the liberty of having it reforged. I have also had your original armor recreated.
0.1: You have been of great service to my reign. It is only fitting to return you to your former status. Please cherish these gifts.

default.0: You carry too much already. Please relieve yourself of some items.
